comment: Tabs conformance timeline. Rest captures sit at least 0.5 s after the action that precedes them. select-tab-2 / select-tab-3 / select-tab-1, then focus-search (keyboard-up, search moves into the navigation bar), type-search (text set programmatically, results filtered to hasPrefix Row 1), cancel-search, scroll-200 on tab 1 (hidesSearchBarWhenScrolling default). show-menu is implemented but omitted: a presented menu hangs on the window. Same file drives Tools/oracle2/confprobe (real UIKit) and `openhost --app Tabs` (the port).
